SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): c = a + b with require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): require(b <= a); c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): c = a * b with overflow require.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): require(b > 0); c = a / b.

Sets allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval(...).
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting ETH.
Caller-controlled address used as owner/spender key in balances, allowed and event emission.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an arbitrary attacker-controlled contract.

Constructor assigns the name state variable.
Constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
Constructor assigns _totalSupply.
Constructor writes balances[0xBCAA...45790] = _totalSupply.
msg.sender is used as the balance owner key inside transfer.
msg.sender is used as the owner key of allowed[] in approve.
msg.sender is used as the spender key of allowed[from][] in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as allowance owner and is forwarded to receiveApproval.
msg.sender is passed as the 'from' argument of the external receiveApproval call.
transfer relies on safeSub for balances[msg.sender] - tokens.
transfer relies on safeAdd for balances[to] + tokens.
transfer writes updated values into the balances mapping.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom subtracts balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] via safeSub.
transferFrom adds tokens to balances[to] via safeAdd.
transferFrom writes updated balances for 'from' and 'to'.
transferFrom decreases the caller allowance in allowed.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply performs _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] subtraction.
safeAdd executes the addition c = a + b.
safeSub executes the subtraction c = a - b.
safeMul executes the multiplication c = a * b.
safeDiv executes the division c = a / b.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an attacker-supplied spender contract, giving it control after the allowance write.
During the receiveApproval callback the spender can re-enter transferFrom and spend the freshly granted allowance.
